notes: acceptable_verdicts is a list, not a single value: any verdict in it counts as correct for this topic_id. evaluate_verdicts.py still records the exact verdict produced for the confusion matrix -- this list only controls what counts as correct.

A null acceptable_verdicts marks a topic this file does not score for verdict accuracy: buy_american_taa_general_compliance and submission_deadline_and_channel, since both are is_text_verifiable: false in true_requirements.json and never get a verdict from a correctly-behaving pipeline.

The application deliberately varies its error types across the four verdict labels and, within non_compliant, across different failure shapes: a missing field (part number), a timing violation (distributor letter deferred to after award), a total omission (business size), and an unsubstantiated claim (or-equal without matching characteristics or literature).
description is copied verbatim from the matching topic_id in true_requirements.json so this file can be read alone; true_requirements.json is the source of truth if the two diverge.

primary_verdict / primary_verdict_source (added by SFT data-prep pass): a single training-target label per topic, additive -- acceptable_verdicts is unchanged and remains the source of truth for verdict-accuracy scoring. primary_verdict is the pipeline's own correct prediction where one exists (source: pipeline_prediction), else acceptable_verdicts[0] (source: acceptable_verdicts_first). null for topics with acceptable_verdicts: null (excluded from SFT training, same as they're excluded from verdict scoring).

verdicts.description: Quote packet must include an Authorized Distributor Letter/Memo from the manufacturer.
verdicts.rationale: The requirement is to include the letter with the quote packet; the application explicitly defers it to after contract award, which is too late.

verdicts.description: Quote must include a Country of Origin for the items being offered.
verdicts.rationale: The application states the item is manufactured in Malaysia in one place and, a few lines later, that all components are made in the USA -- a direct contradiction about the same item's country of origin.

verdicts.description: Quote must include a completed Buy American Certificate (FAR 52.225-2): certify domestic/foreign end-product status per line item, list foreign end products and whether they exceed 55% domestic content, and separately list domestic end products containing a critical component.
verdicts.rationale: Application gives only a generic compliance statement; it never fills in the required per-line-item certification (domestic vs. foreign end product, percent domestic content, critical component listing).

evidence.quote:

compliance with the Buy American Act and Trade Agreements Act for all items
in this quote.

verdicts.description: Quote must include verification that the offered items are not gray market goods.
verdicts.rationale: Application states authorized-reseller status and explicitly denies gray market sourcing.

evidence.quote:

verdicts.description: Quote must indicate whether the offered items are manufactured by a small or large business.
verdicts.rationale: Application never states whether the offered items are manufactured by a small or large business.

verdicts.description: If the offeror holds an FSS contract listing the items, the quote must list the contract number and expiration date.
verdicts.rationale: The requirement only applies to FSS contract holders; the application explicitly states it does not hold one, which satisfies the conditional requirement.

evidence.quote:

verdicts.description: If offering an equivalent product, the quote must show how it meets the salient characteristics in Attachment B (by filling columns F-K of Attachment A or stating where in the submission that information appears), clearly identify the item by brand name and make/model number, include descriptive literature, and clearly describe and mark any planned modifications.
verdicts.rationale: Application identifies the equal product by brand and model, but never addresses how it meets any of the specific salient characteristics in Attachment B (load capacity, height range, tilt angles, safety standards, etc.), includes no descriptive literature, and describes no modifications -- an unsubstantiated equivalence claim.

evidence.quote:

verdicts.description: Quote must include a completed copy of FAR 52.212-3 Offeror Representations and Certifications, unless the offeror's SAM.gov record is already current.
verdicts.rationale: The requirement is satisfied either by including a completed copy or by having a current SAM.gov record; the application explicitly invokes the latter.

evidence.quote:

verdicts.description: Quote must include the completed and signed Non-Manufacturing Rule (NMR) Certification (small business/non-manufacturer status, sourcing, no alteration of goods), including signature, name, title, date, and business name.
verdicts.rationale: Application claims an executed NMR certification exists on file internally, but does not include the signed certification in the quote itself, and does not invoke the SAM.gov-current alternative the way it did for FAR 52.212-3 -- unclear whether the actual certification requirement is met.

evidence.quote:

verdicts.description: Offered product must comply with the Buy American Act, the Trade Agreements Act, and other relevant FAR/agency regulations.
verdicts.rationale: is_text_verifiable: false in true_requirements.json -- actual legal compliance with BAA/TAA cannot be confirmed by reading the quote, only by reviewing the certified content and, ultimately, the product itself.

verdicts.description: Quote must be emailed to the government POC and received no later than 9:00am PT on 08/27/26.
